extension.summary: Watched status, resume points and watchlists kept in Kodi, with TMDb lists
extension.description: Keeps track of what you watch without a server: watched status, resume points, Next Up and your watchlist live in a small database inside Kodi. Lists include Continue Watching, Next Up, In Progress, Watchlist and Recently Watched, plus Trending, Popular and Top Rated from TMDb, search and genres. Every list can be used as a skin widget. Items play through any player add-on you configure, and videos started elsewhere, such as from a skin, are tracked too.
extension.disclaimer: Artwork, details, search and the TMDb lists need a free TMDb API key (Settings, TMDb).
extension.news: 0.1.2: Poster, fanart, logo and episode image sizes in the new Images settings (posters now w342, faster on TVs); widgets reload once after artwork is fetched instead of repeatedly. 0.1.1: Path picker lists installed player files with their add-ons' icons, including ones add-ons ship themselves (no TMDb Helper needed). 0.1.0: First version: local watched status, resume points, Next Up and watchlist; TMDb trending, popular, top rated, search and genres.
